name: chstore
description: Ch.Store: tienda online (React) con API REST y base de datos SQLite

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend-react
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-react"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend-react
